mechanism: Torsemide-induced hypokalemia and hypomagnesemia can potentiate the cardiac effects of atenolol and increase arrhythmia risk, while atenolol may mask tachycardia from volume depletion.
action: Monitor serum potassium and magnesium levels regularly; ensure adequate electrolyte repletion; monitor heart rate and blood pressure, as atenolol may mask compensatory tachycardia from diuresis.
